annotations.title: chainpeek: cross-venue perpetual funding carry ranking across Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid and dYdX

description: chainpeek: Rank cross-venue perpetual funding carry. For Hyperliquid against dYdX alone use compare_funding_rates; for market data use get_perp_markets. Returns the best long and short venue pair per asset across Binance USDT-M, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid and dYdX v4, with the annualised funding spread gross and net of taker fees. Net subtracts four taker legs (open and close on both venues) at `taker_fee_bps`, spread over `holding_days`; with the default 0 bps net equals gross. Rates are normalised to hourly and annualised (simple); a venue that is down is listed in `venues_failed`. Cached up to 60 s. Data only, not trading advice. Bad input is a 422 (not charged). Typically 1-5 s. Price: USD 0.005. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/funding-rate-arbitrage-api.html

holding_days.description: Days the position is held; the fees are amortised over it.

min_volume_usd.description: A venue is only used for a symbol when its 24 h volume there reaches this (USD), so it applies to both legs. Default 0.

symbols.description: Only these base assets (case-insensitive, at most 50), such as BTC. Names listed on fewer than two of the chosen venues are returned in symbols_not_found.

taker_fee_bps.description: Taker fee per side in basis points. Net APR subtracts 4 taker legs (open and close on both venues): 4 x bps / 100 x 365 / holding_days.

venues.description: Subset of hyperliquid, dydx, binance, bybit, okx (at least two). Default: all five.

name: rank_funding_carry

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
